svg.title: Cortex Speech end-to-end architecture
svg.desc: Offline-first Central Kurdish ASR desktop app. Audio flows from import through the Rust pipeline (decode, VAD chunk, ASR, normalize, align, persist), the OmniASR-7B Champion primary engine, the multi-tier jury, human review, SQLite storage, and validation/export. Cloud paths are opt-in and off by default.
svg.text: Offline-first Central Kurdish (Sorani) speech transcription & dataset curation · Tauri v2 + Svelte 5 + Rust · ~102 IPC commands · SQLite/FTS5
5 · JURY (auto-adjudication, own WAL DB connection — jury/)
6 · HUMAN REVIEW (ReviewMode.svelte — human decision is final, never overwritten)
7 · STORAGE (SQLite WAL + FTS5 — db.rs · 25 migrations · all transcripts NFC)

g.text: shared Mutex conn (UI) + jury WAL conn

svg.text: 8 · VALIDATE & EXPORT (honesty-gated dataset build — export*.rs · eval.rs)
9 · CLOUD (consent-gated, default OFF — effective_llm_mode downgrades cloud→none)

g.text: voice = biometric (GDPR Art. 9) · consent + license enforced before publish

svg.text: Cortex Speech · architecture as of 2026-06-30 (main @ 4787d81). Solid violet = OmniASR-7B Champion primary path (default). Dashed = cloud, opt-in & off by default.
